scope: Ten real rdsh/DSH headless processes with deterministic loopback Responses API fixtures. No Gas City, real model inference, tool execution or code editing.
measurement: A loopback response barrier waits for all ten workers before replying. Aggregate worker process-tree RSS is sampled from procfs every 100ms; it can miss short peaks and counts shared pages repeatedly. Fixture server memory is excluded. CPU values are GNU time sums, not instantaneous host utilization. One sample, not a capacity bound.
isolation: Each worker has fresh HOME, DSH_HOME, workspace and TMPDIR; inherited credentials are excluded by an environment allowlist. Only a dummy loopback key is supplied. Each process has a 30-second deadline and 2-second kill grace.
verification: Saved JSONL was checked for ten distinct session IDs, matching per-worker workspace, completed turn_end, exact final LOCAL_OK_N, exit 0 and one model request each. Final script incorporates the same checks; node --check and git diff --check passed. No broader product regression suite was rerun for this standalone test script/documentation change.
limitations: Gas City orchestration, CloudBackend, Kubernetes and real model inference were not exercised.
The headless smoke profile explicitly disables unbuilt typert/loader/gateway components; the full DSH runtime remains unqualified.
Workspace and session separation are configuration checks, not a security isolation test.
Real editing, builds and long-running tasks will have different resource use.
